properties.headline: 92.7% occupied / 97.3% pre-leased; debt maturity

recommendations.title: Name permanent coverage for Nicole's assets this week
recommendations.detail: Eleven properties and 3,705 units - including the three most cash-stressed (Skye Reserve, Hanley, Skye Ridge) - need a named asset manager. Confirm Megan's interim scope, decide the Mike/Garrett split, and update the Section 10 reference and email list so owners and lenders know who to call.

recommendations.title: Put Hanley on a 13-week cash plan
recommendations.detail: With AP at nearly 4x cash and vendors suspending service, rank payables by life-safety, lien risk and revenue impact, and decide this week whether Slate JV cash (~$400K) funds the gap. Pair it with Section 8 ledger cleanup to recover the $50-60K delinquency.

recommendations.title: Fund or replace the Skye Ridge capital call before liens attach
recommendations.detail: The asset is not covering debt service. Lock the $400K call date or activate the ~$103K backup, pay lien-risk vendors first, and hold full renovations of the five vacated units until cash is in.

recommendations.title: Turn Skye Reserve's 18 not-ready units
recommendations.detail: Leasing demand is there (21 of 22 move-ins on track); the constraint is make-ready capacity. Approve contract make-ready labor until the maintenance manager and housekeeper roles are filled, and lock the cash-flow-mortgage path before the lender package is rebuilt.

recommendations.title: Manage Upland to paying occupancy, not physical
recommendations.detail: 93% physical vs ~78% paying means 30-plus units produce no cash. Keep cash-for-keys and the 10th-of-month filing rule, and budget 2027 off paying occupancy so NOI stops missing by 11%.

recommendations.title: Settle the Dallas tax plan before year-end
recommendations.detail: Get the attorney's minimum-payment number and lender approval for 9944 and Parks at Walnut now; the $4,500 Parks appraisal is small relative to a $16.7M assessed value. Size any Dec 1 capital call early.

recommendations.title: Close the reporting gaps
recommendations.detail: Nightingale, Ninety-Nine 44, Parks at Walnut, both Skye Oaks parcels and Skye Ridge produced no occupancy figure this week. Ask RPM/Slate for a per-property weekly KPI export (occupancy, collections, delinquency) so the dashboard does not depend on meeting coverage.
